title: Glossary
summary: The words of Overrank in one place: awakened, rift, spoils, grade, forge, Pantheon...

blocks.text: Each term has its own page, linked from the other pages. There are 24 terms ; add the ones we forgot.

rows.text: A player: a human whose mana awoke. The game calls players awakened (no longer hunters).
The unawakened state (class None): no class, +8% all stats, +10% XP, the whole General tree open.
An awakened's rank, E to S, then S+ (level 175) and Nation (level 250 + the System's trial), measured at the Awakened Registry.
The Registry's mana measurement: free, once a minute, gives the highest rank whose requirements are met.
A gate opening in the city that leads to a procedural dungeon of its rank.
A rare blood-red rift: monsters and loot one rank above, x1.5 XP and shards, a longer dungeon.
A rift left until its timer runs out may break: monsters invade its district in waves.
The boss at the end of a dungeon; the dungeon's theme decides which one.
The reel after a guardian: one prize per awakened (equipment, shards, a boost or a rare item).
An item's rank letter, from its rarity: F (Trash), E, D, C, B, A, S (Mythic); EX (Limited editions) and SP (exclusive rewards) above.
Gear of the ranks above S, found from rank S+ / Nation; Nation weapons only from a guardian's rare roll.
Upgrades an item (+1 .. +10, +25, +30), climbs its grade, or rerolls its bonuses.
A hidden class (Spellblade, Survivor, Warper, Bipolar, Berserker, Reaper, Chad, Overlord) unlocked by a secret feat; level cap 999.
The battle pass's skill tree: skills unlocked by pass levels, for every class.
The weapon's own skill, on key E.
A cosmetic box: 9 cosmetics, one of them secret.
A dungeon event: beyond the guardian, a second dungeon one rank above.
The board of the fastest System's trial times (rank Nation).
The multiplier on drop chances and on the spoils' higher grades; every bonus adds up, x6 at most.
A stone dropped by dungeon guardians (12 kinds, Common to Mythic), engraved into a weapon, armor or pendant at the Rune Temple for a small bonus while the item is worn.
A mark added to a weapon or an armor at the forge with essences: each star gives the item +4% of its own stats inside dungeons, 5 at most.
What stars cost: every dungeon boss gives some to the awakened who helped defeat it, more for a higher rank.
One of the 25 kiosks of the city's transit network: pick a stop and travel there at once, for free (not during a fight).

TermMeaning
AwakenedA player: a human whose mana awoke. The game calls players awakened (no longer hunters).
HumanThe unawakened state (class None): no class, +8% all stats, +10% XP, the whole General tree open.
RankAn awakened's rank, E to S, then S+ (level 175) and Nation (level 250 + the System's trial), measured at the Awakened Registry.
Re-evaluationThe Registry's mana measurement: free, once a minute, gives the highest rank whose requirements are met.
RiftA gate opening in the city that leads to a procedural dungeon of its rank.
Red rift / anomalyA rare blood-red rift: monsters and loot one rank above, x1.5 XP and shards, a longer dungeon.
Rift breakA rift left until its timer runs out may break: monsters invade its district in waves.
GuardianThe boss at the end of a dungeon; the dungeon's theme decides which one.
Guardian spoilsThe reel after a guardian: one prize per awakened (equipment, shards, a boost or a rare item).
ShardsThe game's currency.
GradeAn item's rank letter, from its rarity: F (Trash), E, D, C, B, A, S (Mythic); EX (Limited editions) and SP (exclusive rewards) above.
S+ / Nation editionGear of the ranks above S, found from rank S+ / Nation; Nation weapons only from a guardian's rare roll.
ForgeUpgrades an item (+1 .. +10, +25, +30), climbs its grade, or rerolls its bonuses.

System ArtsThe battle pass's skill tree: skills unlocked by pass levels, for every class.

PantheonThe board of the fastest System's trial times (rank Nation).
LuckThe multiplier on drop chances and on the spoils' higher grades; every bonus adds up, x6 at most.
RuneA stone dropped by dungeon guardians (12 kinds, Common to Mythic), engraved into a weapon, armor or pendant at the Rune Temple for a small bonus while the item is worn.
StarA mark added to a weapon or an armor at the forge with essences: each star gives the item +4% of its own stats inside dungeons, 5 at most.
EssenceWhat stars cost: every dungeon boss gives some to the awakened who helped defeat it, more for a higher rank.
Transit kioskOne of the 25 kiosks of the city's transit network: pick a stop and travel there at once, for free (not during a fight).
